source: Block 5's release bar set (RUN_STATE item 83 ruling 1: the recompute's coded bars of commit 7e322b767 bind block 5's release; item 84: the meter line follows the registered parser definition). Equal to tests/independent_recompute/bar_sets/recompute_coded_7e322b76.json family by family, plus the whole-machine meter families meter_j, meter_w, machine_j and rho under the same rule. Fixed before any real block-5 value is seen; not widened. Block 6's S-13 set stays in tests/independent_recompute/bar_sets/s13_block6.json.
rule: bar = max(absolute, relative * |L9 value|, half a unit of printed_decimals when given)

run_phase_energy_j.derivation: unrounded joules: 1e-6 relative to the L9 value, 1e-6 J absolute near zero (recompute agreement policy, commit 7e322b767, audit F12); exceeds 1e6 x binary64 noise (2.2e-10 relative)

floor_j.derivation: unrounded joules: 1e-6 relative to the L9 value, 1e-6 J absolute near zero (recompute agreement policy, commit 7e322b767, audit F12); exceeds 1e6 x binary64 noise (2.2e-10 relative)

floor_gate_j.derivation: unrounded joules: 1e-6 relative to the L9 value, 1e-6 J absolute near zero (recompute agreement policy, commit 7e322b767, audit F12); exceeds 1e6 x binary64 noise (2.2e-10 relative)

dominance_ratio.derivation: dimensionless ratio of joules: 1e-6 relative, 1e-6 absolute near zero (same rule as joules, commit 7e322b767)

reported_cell_j.derivation: unrounded joules: 1e-6 relative to the L9 value, 1e-6 J absolute near zero (recompute agreement policy, commit 7e322b767, audit F12); exceeds 1e6 x binary64 noise (2.2e-10 relative)

contrast_j.derivation: unrounded joules: 1e-6 relative to the L9 value, 1e-6 J absolute near zero (recompute agreement policy, commit 7e322b767, audit F12); exceeds 1e6 x binary64 noise (2.2e-10 relative)

contrast_p.derivation: p values: 1e-6 absolute, no relative part (commit 7e322b767)

descriptive_ratio.derivation: dimensionless ratio of joules: 1e-6 relative, 1e-6 absolute near zero (same rule as joules, commit 7e322b767)

per_token_j.derivation: unrounded joules: 1e-6 relative to the L9 value, 1e-6 J absolute near zero (recompute agreement policy, commit 7e322b767, audit F12); exceeds 1e6 x binary64 noise (2.2e-10 relative); joules per token

b_op_s.derivation: seconds: 1e-6 relative only, as coded in commit 7e322b767 (b_op is a positive duration, never near zero)

count.derivation: counts and integer-ns window edges: exact (commit 7e322b767: counts and windows exact; one 50 Hz sample moves meter energy by more than the joule bar)

meter_j.derivation: unrounded joules: 1e-6 relative to the L9 value, 1e-6 J absolute near zero (recompute agreement policy, commit 7e322b767, audit F12); exceeds 1e6 x binary64 noise (2.2e-10 relative); gross meter energy and meter delta over a member's request span

meter_w.derivation: unrounded watts: 1e-6 relative, 1e-6 W absolute near zero (commit 7e322b767: 'unrounded J or W 1e-6 relative'); meter baseline power

machine_j.derivation: unrounded joules: 1e-6 relative to the L9 value, 1e-6 J absolute near zero (recompute agreement policy, commit 7e322b767, audit F12); exceeds 1e6 x binary64 noise (2.2e-10 relative); dE_machine, dE_rail and the battery term of the whole-machine line

rho.derivation: rho = dE_rail / dE_machine: 1e-6 absolute, no relative part (commit 7e322b767: 1% of its four-decimal printed resolution, 1e-4)
